scope: Poll writes that ignore the leave purge mark: savePoll for an OPEN poll and allocateVoteSeq must check purgedGroups inside their own readwrite transaction (same idiom as the pending queues and saveVoteIfNewer).

behavior.savePoll_open: On a purged group writes nothing, resolves null, posts no store-changed notice. Otherwise unchanged (upsert by id, returns the poll).
behavior.allocateVoteSeq: On a purged group rejects (caller must not send), creates no reservation row. Otherwise unchanged (max(last+1, floor), durable, Web Locks wrapper kept).
behavior.handleOpen: Returns early when savePoll resolves null.
behavior.release: releasePollPurgeMark on re-join (and clearAllPollData) remain the only releases.

constraints: Mark check and write in the same readwrite transaction, inside enqueue(key, ...)
Closed-poll savePoll path, queues, saveVoteIfNewer and clearPollData untouched
Receipt clock (few:poll-receipt-clock) is a single global key, never deleted by a group purge: no change
non_goals: Cross-tab coverage of the purge mark (finding multi-tab-mls-cache-coherence)
PollStoreContext.createPoll optimistic-state adjustment for a purged group (cosmetic, group is being left)
Persisting the purge mark across reloads
notes: pollOrdering.test.ts: the two allocation fault-injection cases moved from mocked get/set to the transaction faults, since allocateVoteSeq now runs in one pollTxn. The report names the reservation key few:poll-seq-reservations:<g>; the real key is few:poll-vote-seq:<g>.
